_schema: Example only: every name, price and URL here is a placeholder. Copy this file, replace everything with what you found today, and delete this _schema field. Required: request.category, request.pincode, checked_on, advice, and 1-5 picks. Each pick needs name, best_for, why (list), drawbacks (list), at least one price {site, price, url, checked_on} and at least one source {title, url}. Optional: key_specs (object), offers (list), service {status: found | not_found | not_checked, detail, url}, prices[].variant, prices[].delivery (yes | no | not_checked), also_considered [{name, why_not}], assumptions (list), not_confirmed (list).

request.notes: Wants a simple phone with a good camera for family photos.

advice: Example Phone A: best camera in this budget, and its service centre is in the nearest town. Example Phone B if battery matters more than photos.

picks.best_for: Best camera in this budget; battery is average
offers: Placeholder: ₹1,000 off with an example bank card
